comment: Image-route policy of `jjv layout` / `jjv images` (Q-2). The domain table is DATA on purpose: engine source stays domain-neutral. A domain that is not listed has NO provider (everything refused). A domain's own `images.allowed_providers` (CONFIG-PATCH) may only TIGHTEN this list. Every numeric value marked GUESS is policy, not a measurement. v002 (user 2026-10-30): NEWTECONS images go HYBRID (comfyui-local + codex-exec + codex-adopt, then compare, user picks); OpenRouter stays refused for NEWTECONS. v001 is kept byte for byte.
